about: Pre-2004 per-game feasibility probe, 2026-10-21. Spot checks only, not a harvest. Each row is one game line found in an open (or receipt-only) source, with the verbatim quote string-checked by scripts/check-receipts.mjs against the saved page text in pages/. 'ocr' rows quote archive.org's OCR (djvu.txt), so the match proves the quote is on the page text, not that the OCR read the digits correctly; 'ocr_digits_verified' says whether the values were also checked against an independent source.
